edits.current:
- name: Require nominal Ruby packages on the pinned interpreter
        if: matrix.profile == 'ruby'
        timeout-minutes: 45
        env:
          LEAN_NUM_THREADS: "2"
        run: |
          source scripts/env.sh
          bash scripts/run-nominal-subtype-ruby-ci.sh "$(command -v ruby)" "$(command -v gem)"
      - name: Preserve complete and partial nominal Ruby records
        if: always() && matrix.profile == 'ruby'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: nominal-subtype-ruby-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/nominal-subtype-ruby-ci/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

edits.current:
These local runs do not measure dispatch counts or establish hosted
release-floor acceptance.

### Subtypes in copied records

Use the generated frozen, keyword-initialized class for a copied record or
variant. Pass ordinary Ruby `Integer` values in its Nat Subtype fields. The
package runs the checked Lean constructor selected for each input site. Two
exports can choose different constructors for the same record, including
different normalization. Only the active variant case runs its field
constructors. Rejection leaves the caller's values unchanged; subsequent valid
calls still work.

Copied results contain existing Lean values projected into the generated
classes, without proof fields or an input-constructor call. A package that only
returns those values needs no input constructor selections. Arrays and lists
use Ruby `Array` values, while `Some`, `Ok` and `Err` retain their branches.

The [installed nominal checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-ruby-acceptance-20261012.md)
cover the tested Nat fields, aliases, mixed Fin guards and standalone
constructor-free result packages on MRI Ruby 3.3.12. Both author routes
reproduce gems, install offline without author sources and replay unchanged
callers after moving the installed tree. These runs use Linux x64/glibc 2.36.
Other primitive-base nominal fixtures, refined callbacks, owned, recursive,
dependent and broader generic Subtypes remain pending.

edits.previous: Copied results do not need an input constructor: Lean has already produced the proof-carrying value. Omit the result's `refinement` in an ordinary export contract, or omit `contracts` entirely for a result-only package with unrefined inputs. The adapter projects `.val`; it does not run a constructor on the output. Fresh [native](../evidence/subtype-result-20261011.md) and [component](../evidence/component-nominal-subtype-20261011.md) compiler checks cover primitive bases inside scalars, structural containers, aliases and acyclic plain records and variants. The shared component compiler no longer requires a result constructor selection. [Installed npm checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-npm-acceptance-20261011.md) now cover the tested Nat results on both source routes, including standalone result-only packages. [Installed C/C++ checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-native-acceptance-20261011.md) cover the same Nat result forms on both source routes, including standalone result-only packages, on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. [Installed Perl checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-perl-acceptance-20261012.md) cover the tested Nat fields and constructor-free results on both source routes, with all four pinned ABIs, both installation modes and relocated replay on Linux x64/glibc 2.36. [Nominal Python checks](../evidence/nominal-subtype-python-acceptance-20261012.md) add those Nat forms on CPython 3.11 and 3.12 using the same reproduced wheel, offline installation and relocated replay. Browser, other native hosts and PHP-Wasm installed acceptance for these additions remains pending.
